title: a Filipino street food inspired bbq cooking game
author: zehehed
selftext:
Hello guys!

Just wanted to share a work in progress of a game i’ve been working on for the past 3 months

Right now it’s browser based and fully built with Claude and Gemini for the pixel-art

Mechanics of the game is to cook filipino bbq by fanning the grill through swiping left and right which increases the heat, and you can flip the BBQ on either side to make each side is perfectly cooked.

You can also add BBQ sauce on either side for bonus points, and swipe up to serve to customers.

Hoping to get this game out soon for you guys to play around and test :) 

Would appreciate any early feedback. Thanks! 🙏

comments.author: LaCaipirinha
comments.body: The long awaited return of time management games haha, love it, very creative
